scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,worker,dashboard -c blue,yellow,green "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:worker" "npm run dev:dashboard"
scripts.docker:logs: docker compose -f infra/docker/docker-compose.local.yml logs -f mysql redis
scripts.db:reset: docker compose -f infra/docker/docker-compose.local.yml down -v && docker compose -f infra/docker/docker-compose.local.yml up -d mysql redis
scripts.test:integration: tsx --test apps/api/test/mysql-repositories.integration.spec.ts && npm run api:build && npm run worker:build && tsx --test apps/api/test/api-workflows.integration.spec.js
scripts.save: git add -A && git commit -m "wip: checkpoint $(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M')" || echo 'Nothing to commit'
